translations./task_policies/0/description: Choose the next crate by terrain-weighted traversal cost to reduce expected completion time.
translations./task_policies/1/description: Minimize the route's worst terrain risk first, then compare total traversal cost.
translations./task_policies/2/description: Compare recoverable value per unit of traversal cost and favor high-value crates.
translations./task_policies/3/description: Combine route distance, terrain cost, and value instead of chasing one metric.
